rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking or supposing that something is true.

example.english: I reckon he will not come back today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this for calculating an amount, total, or figure rather than merely counting items.

example.english: I reckon all this will cost three hundred dollars.
example.traditional: 我計過條數，買晒呢啲要三百蚊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gai3 gwo3 tiu4 sou3 maai5 saai3 ni1 di1 jiu3 saam1 baak3 man1

rows.note: Use this specifically for counting or enumerating items one by one.

example.english: I reckon there are ten oranges; I counted them one by one.
example.traditional: 我數過晒啲橙，總共有十個。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sou2 gwo3 saai3 di1 caang2 zung2 gung6 jau5 sap6 go3
